title: Outcome Briefings Feed
purpose: Finished-output feed for Matrix Brain. Each item turns a tracker lane into meaning, likely next move, records needed and watch triggers.
boundary: Evidence-graded outputs only. Unsupported claims remain labelled as unsupported until records change.

items.headline: Why records are withheld matters as much as what is released.
items.meaning: Map category, legal reason, record index and changed release batches.
items.likelyNext: More partial release, argument over categories and pressure for clearer explanation.

items.headline: The strongest public pattern is convergence across access systems.
items.meaning: Track mandates, vendors, data fields, access rules and appeal routes.
items.likelyNext: More interoperability and more disputes over privacy, consent and exclusion risk.

items.headline: Gold must be mapped by ownership and custody separately.
items.meaning: Reported tonnes do not prove vault location, audit quality or unencumbered ownership.
items.likelyNext: Gold remains a reserve-power signal during debt, sanctions and currency stress.

items.headline: Influence becomes visible through infrastructure, contracts and dependency.
items.meaning: Map filings, holdings, boards, grants, contracts and public-private routes.
items.likelyNext: More power concentration in cloud, AI, payments, energy, defense, data and identity infrastructure.

items.headline: Speculation must produce records, not certainty.
items.meaning: Every claim needs exact source, missing records, counter-source and probability condition.
items.likelyNext: Stronger pages when testable leads are separated from unsupported claims.
